hypothesis: Phase-specific discrete retention reduces redundant WU traffic at near-fixed completion time while preserving old arms and correct snapshots.
timer_semantics: F_K(r)=r+((phi-r) mod P)+(K-1)P; modulo in[0,P-1]; K1 can expire at reception;255 is infinity, not finite.
guest_layout: same immutable ELF and five-digit stage load fields; schedule expresses nominal K*P cycles, infinity separately tagged; exact API binding recorded before execution
fixed_reference: Find the fastest max-J fixed load across all255 legal K and three training offsets. This defines the common time anchor. Among fixed loads within1.001 times that anchor, minimize max-WU, then max-J, then lexicographicK; this traffic-optimal eligible fixed is the deployed fixed comparator.
phase_selection: Use the identical1.001-times-fastest-fixed-maxJ cap for the24 nonconstant phase vectors. Minimize max-WU, then max-J, then lexicographicK. Deploy phase only if its max-WU is strictly smaller than the best eligible fixed under the same objective; else deploy fixed. Also retain strict-min-J fixed/phase choices as diagnostics.
time_guard_rationale: A prespecified0.1 percent measured completion-time tolerance exposes the time/traffic tradeoff; it is not a task WCET guarantee. Analytical all-path task admission is evaluated separately.
validation: Freeze after exhaustive fixed and24phase training, before heldout data. Each heldout input/geometry/offset runs16 predeclared fixed diagnostics, selected nonconstant phase, its identical-guest suppression, WI/WU contexts, AND frozen training-selected fixed if absent from16. Report the frozen fixed and the diagnostic oracle distinctly. Both frozen fastest-time fixed and matched-objective traffic fixed are always measured on heldout inputs if absent from the16diagnostics.
offset_sweep: After freezing, run all128 offsets on32KiB,N32 for frozen fixed, chosen phase and matched suppressed-write. No reselection. Representative offsets are not labelled worst-case offsets.
correctness: Every run requires terminal0, expected changing-payload checksum, exact phase/completion markers, no invariant failures, four whole-system epoch counters reconciled.
replication: Deterministic simulator comparisons; tick offsets/input sizes are conditions, not independent stochastic replicates. No confidence interval manufactured from these conditions.
scope: Four-client native system traffic/time and event semantics. The two-client71cycle theorem and supplied compute/private upper bounds remain separate. No target-CPU WCET or whole-cache area claim.

resource_amendment.reason: Use four independent serial simulator processes after compilation/validation handoff to shorten wall time. Scientific conditions, simulated cycles, selection rule and candidate set unchanged.

control_amendment.reason: The new native API implements every eight-bit load and infinity, enabling the strongest exhaustive fixed training baseline. Added before observing any new training results. Heldout diagnostics remain prespecified plus the frozen training winner.

objective_amendment.reason: Apply the same time/traffic objective and measured-time slack to both policy families; comparing a traffic-selected phase with a time-only fixed would be unfair. No candidate/results or heldout data have been observed.
